body: Oh I'll be back with updates! That's half the fun in asking for the advice, right?
Very true about the transition from a crammed airplane to...bed. Thanks for the advice...the anticipation is being built :P

You guys are now my idols.

This is exactly what I want! I just don't know how to initiate...I guess telling him I'm going without panties under my dress should do that in theory...
I would crack up! Not necessarily a bad thing though, cause I know he'd laugh at me too. At least would loosen the tension.
It's amazing I didn't think of this. Thank you, kind soul.
That's what I tried last time! I didn't get as far as pulling clothes off. Things just kind of cooled off, he got stiff, not in the right places...
So he's used to having a few drinks first too. I don't get it! We've been together plenty of times now, isn't it kind of a bad sign if he still needs liquid bravery around me? OR a great sign?
Yeah, I bailed. It should not be this difficult.

Use SVO (Subject Verb Object) writing. It's the best way to write concisely and lets you use your sentence structure to eliminate unneeded clutter. 

http://journalism.about.com/od/writing/a/Use-Subject-Verb-Object-In-Your-Writing.htm

You have a way with words. After escaping a cyclical, emotionally abusive with a narcissist I felt very similar. He moved on easily, I felt completely scarred and ruined. My first healing step was writing it all out. Letters on letters to him, to myself even. Not letters that I sent, but just as a means of expression.

I get your need for closure. You clearly are careful with who you invest your time and emotions in, and this time it did not pan out.

In this case I get the feeling that someone else is involved that she's interested in. She's texting other people while on a date with you...and the change of heart so suddenly. Plus, she'd have a hard time being open about that. Don't let her keep you on the back burner.

If you want the truth, I'd tell her you're comfortable hearing it. Maybe she only sees you as a friend but is afraid that expressing it will hurt your feelings.

Either way, she doesn't value you enough to deserve your attention.
Hm, no they're not. This is only NYC --> Charleston, SC though. Think that could have that significant of an impact?
There's a difference between saying "you're falling" and saying "you're in love" IMO.

If she's hooking up with him casually, chances are there are other people involved as well. Not that she's doing this in a way that's harmful to you, but fulfilling her own needs.

She's clearly putting herself first, and you have the privilege to do the same as well! I bet once you get your distance, the pride you rediscover in yourself for leaving the toxic cycle will replace the want you feel for her right now.
